claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive lineage-choice bundle
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The trait is one species-trait record that requires a build-time choice among three heterogeneous option bundles, not three separate always-on singleton grants.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: character-level-gated passive grants
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The chosen lineage passively unlocks additional grants at character levels 3 and 5, but PassiveMechanics has no threshold-gated grant wrapper.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access casting-ability override
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The granted lineage spells use a chosen ability score specific to this trait, but grant_spell_access cannot currently say which ability governs those casts.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access spell-list cantrip choice with long-rest replacement
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: High Elf's level-1 benefit is not a fixed spellId; it is a cantrip chosen from the Wizard spell list and replaceable after each Long Rest.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace that cantrip with a different cantrip from the Wizard spell list.
